reports.title: Jordan Howarth: Prevention of future deaths report
categories: Hospital Death (Clinical Procedures and medical management) related deaths

promises.quote: The joint approach to Mr [name redacted] care from both the microbiologist and the consultant physician, specifically around the decision to withhold antibiotics.
promises.summary: Add microbiology input section to daily review chart and audit compliance

promises.quote: The documentation from the ICU consultant setting out/not setting out their rationale, specifically no discussions' between the medical consultant and the ICU consultant within the medical notes
promises.summary: Implement Martha's Rule for 24/7 rapid review access

promises.quote: The Trusts' policy around NEWS2 escalation had not been followed
promises.summary: Conduct bi-annual NEWS2 audits and take urgent action on low compliance

concerns.quote: whilst there was input into Jordan's care from both the microbiologist and the consultant physician there was not a joint approach to his care and no detailed discussions regarding the decision to withhold antibiotics

Critical Care Outreach Practitioner had identified that Jordan needed to be moved to ICU urgently. This view had then to be ratified by the ICU Consultant if he was to be accepted into ICU. There was no documentation from the ICU consultant setting out their rationale for not examining Jordan at that point and for declining to admit him at that point
concerns.hazard: lack of documented rationale for ICU admission refusal

concerns.quote: anyone who had a NEWS2 score of 5 and no ceiling of care should be referred to the CC Outreach team. The inquest heard evidence that this was not followed on a number of occasions and the fact it had been missed was not identified by more senior members of the nursing team
concerns.hazard: failure to refer patients with NEWS2 score 5 to CC Outreach

concerns.quote: no evidence of a multi-disciplinary discussion/approach to assess his position fully and that it was unclear who was responsible for the continuity of his care
concerns.hazard: absence of multidisciplinary discussion and unclear care continuity

reports.title: Catherine Kirkham: Prevention of future deaths report

concerns.quote: entries within these systems are extensive and not easily navigable, making it difficult to identify key information such as a patient's vaccination status
treating doctor failed to record a clear clinical diagnosis and did not document the administration of a tetanus booster, despite later stating he believed it had been given
concerns.hazard: failure to document tetanus booster administration

concerns.quote: prescription of oral antibiotics without conducting a swallow assessment in a patient presenting with swallowing difficulties and lockjaw
concerns.hazard: oral antibiotics prescribed without swallow assessment

concerns.quote: failures in the Urgent Treatment Centre, Emergency Department, and in the GP referral
concerns.hazard: missed tetanus risk identification across care points
